request.query: multivariate Hasse derivative commutes with injective renaming variables

items.name: MvPolynomial.pderiv_rename
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type v} [inst : CommSemiring R] {τ : Type u_1} {f : σ → τ},
  Function.Injective f →
    ∀ (x : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
      (MvPolynomial.pderiv (f x)) ((MvPolynomial.rename f) p) = (MvPolynomial.rename f) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv x) p)

items.name: MvPolynomial.bind₁_rename
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] {υ : Type u_6} (f : τ → MvPolynomial υ R)
  (g : σ → τ) (φ : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.bind₁ f) ((MvPolynomial.rename g) φ) = (MvPolynomial.bind₁ (f ∘ g)) φ

items.name: MvPolynomial.rename_bind₁
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] {υ : Type u_6} (f : σ → MvPolynomial τ R)
  (g : τ → υ) (φ : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.rename g) ((MvPolynomial.bind₁ f) φ) = (MvPolynomial.bind₁ fun i => (MvPolynomial.rename g) (f i)) φ

items.name: MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous.rename_isHomogeneous_iff
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] {φ : MvPolynomial σ R} {n : ℕ} {f : σ → τ},
  Function.Injective f → (((MvPolynomial.rename f) φ).IsHomogeneous n ↔ φ.IsHomogeneous n)

items.type:
